## What each capability does

- **`capture`** (agentic): Extract know-how proposals (create, merge, update, retire, contradiction) from untrusted sources.
- **`verify`** (human): A cabinet member accepts, edits or rejects a proposal. The only way into the knowledge base.
- **`surface`** (agentic): Rank the verified know-how relevant to what the cabinet is about to do.
- **`ask`** (agentic): Answer a question from verified know-how only, with citations, or say it is not known and who to ask.
- **`find-gaps`** (agentic): Find missing, stale, unverified or contradictory know-how and phrase questions about it.
- **`build-handover`** (deterministic): Assemble a role's handover pack from verified know-how and open gaps; every line cites its source.
- **`plan-interview`** (agentic): Turn a role's gaps into a short, prioritized interview for the outgoing officer.
- **`intake`** (agentic): Turn a free-text event description into an EventSpec with per-field provenance.
- **`apply-rules`** (agentic): Judge each current AUB rule as applies / not applicable / uncertain; code derives requirements.
- **`draft-proposal`** (agentic): Answer the OSA proposal form from the spec, club profile and rules, each answer with its origin.
- **`plan-backward`** (deterministic): Compute task due dates backward from the event date using rule lead times.
- **`plan-event`** (agentic): Agent loop: chooses its own steps (memory, past events, rules, calendar, proposal), asks when information is missing, stops at its step and cost limits.
- **`draft`** (agentic): Write one draft (announcement, email, caption, poster text, expense form, shifts, impact report) from a template; a person copies or sends it.
- **`calendar-items`** (deterministic): Turn an approved plan into calendar items with default reminders (docs/calendar-contract.md).
- **`suggest-replacement`** (agentic): When a sponsor drops out, propose replacements for the same category from the club's relationships.

Totals: 11 agentic, 3 deterministic, 1 human-only.
